svg.text: PHASE box: each signal exists x GEAR (dfi_*_p0.._p(GEAR-1)) - command CA/CS/CKE/ODT + write + read data; scale with the frequency ratio. COMMON box: single-instance control-clk handshakes (status/freq/update/error/low-power) - NO phase replication.
